newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Prentiss Properties a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Prentiss Properties a buy.

text.p: -- Lehman Brothers said it started coverage of Prentiss Properties Trust with a buy rating.
-- Lehman set a 12-month price target of $26.

-- "Prentiss Properties owns a diversified portfolio of 28 office buildings and 59 industrial properties in 10 major U.S. markets and manages 30 million square feet for third parties. We believe that Presntiss is well-positioned for growth given its low leverage, national infrastructure, experienced management team, and attractive markets in which it operates," Lehman said.
